catalog.title: WoW Forever: only 10 minutes to play? Do these 3 things #shorts
catalog.description:
Only 10 minutes before bed? What's worth it in WoW Forever:
1) Turn in finished quests: quick XP, sometimes a whole level.
2) Visit a trainer: new class spells, or a profession like First Aid (in Bloodhoof Village the First Aid trainer stands right in the inn).
3) Log off in an inn or a city: the Zzz on your portrait means rested XP, bonus experience next time you play.
Don't start in 10 minutes: a dungeon or an escort quest (you walk an NPC somewhere, no pausing).

Shown in-game with our own character (checked Nov 5, 2026). Rested XP in Forever: see also Blizzard News, "Gather Around the Campfire in World of Warcraft: Forever" https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24301516 (Camp Tent).
